checks: packaged Feishu/core/diagnostics load on an external official ACP profile with native webServer
real webhook verifies challenge/source/app/admin and ignores bot messages before Agent admission
text executes an actual native tool and replies with its receipt; event/message redelivery cannot execute twice
webhook acknowledges while Agent is held; same-chat queue is serial and another thread runs independently
status and owned one-use callbacks bypass held work; forged actor/chat/message is refused and /stop cancels the native Agent
confirmed rate limit retries only delivery with the same UUID; lost send receipt becomes unknown without Agent rerun
restart preserves mapping/history and deduplication, never resends unknown delivery, and accepts only valid signed/encrypted input
P2 /model lists the native catalog and changes the next actual model request without model-assisted command parsing
P2 /cd creates a native workspace session, changes actual Shell cwd, rejects root escape and persists cwd/model through restart
forced process termination recovers durable pending work and interrupted native receipts without resubmitting running requests
forced termination during remote send preserves an unknown outcome instead of duplicating the message on restart
disabled bundle unregisters webhook and worker while the official carrier remains alive
official uninstall removes all bundles and preserves channel business data
